name: Clark MacGregor
bio: A Representative from Minnesota; born in Minneapolis, Hennepin County, Minn., July 12, 1922; graduated from Washburn High School, Minneapolis, Minn.; A.B., Dartmouth College, Hanover, N.H., 1946; LL.B., University of Minnesota Law School, 1948; United States Army, Office of Strategic Services, 1942-1945; lawyer, private practice; delegate, Republican National Conventions, 1964 and 1968; elected as a Republican to the Eighty-seventh and to the four succeeding Congresses (January 3, 1961-January 3, 1971); not a candidate for reelection to the Ninety-second Congress in 1970, but was an unsuccessful nominee to the United States Senate; business executive; died on February 10, 2003, in Pompano Beach, Fla.
